units.rawText: Do you have any lofty aspirations, Professor?
units.displayText: Do you have any lofty aspirations, Professor?

spans.text: Do you have any lofty aspirations, Professor?

units.rawText: Me...? I dream of ending all war, strife and bloodshed in the world one day. Then no one will get hurt, suffer, or die.
units.displayText: Me...? I dream of ending all war, strife and bloodshed in the world one day. Then no one will get hurt, suffer, or die.

spans.text: Me...? I dream of ending all war, strife and bloodshed in the world one day. Then no one will get hurt, suffer, or die.

units.rawText: When that day comes, my mission will be over, I suppose...
units.displayText: When that day comes, my mission will be over, I suppose...

spans.text: When that day comes, my mission will be over, I suppose...

units.rawText: But until then, I must keep performing my duty.
